# viettelcloud_volume_snapshot_policy (Resource)

Manage a Viettel Cloud volume snapshot policy, which takes snapshots of its volumes on a weekly schedule. Deleting a policy detaches it from its volumes, so set `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }` on a policy in use.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "viettelcloud_volume_snapshot_policy" "nightly" {
  name        = "example-nightly"
  description = "Weekday snapshots at 02:00 UTC"
  region      = { name = "vn-central-1" }
  status      = "enabled"
  retention   = 7

  schedule = {
    days_of_week = ["mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri"]
    time         = "02:00"
  }

  # Deleting a policy removes it from the volumes that use it.
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Snapshot policy name.
- `region` (Attributes) Project region of the snapshot policy. Changing it replaces the snapshot policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--region))
- `schedule` (Attributes) Weekly schedule on which the policy takes snapshots. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `status` (String) Policy status: enabled or disabled.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Snapshot policy description. Omitting it preserves the current value. An empty string clears it.
- `retention` (Number) Number of snapshots that the policy keeps for each volume. Omitting it at creation keeps 1. Omitting it later preserves the current value.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Snapshot policy ID (UUID).
- `last_execution` (String) Time of the latest policy run (RFC3339). Null before the first run.
- `state` (String) State of the latest policy run: ready, running, done, or fail.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC3339).
- `volume_count` (Number) Number of volumes that use the policy.

<a id="nestedatt--region"></a>
### Nested Schema for `region`

Required:

- `name` (String) Region name.


<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Required:

- `days_of_week` (Set of String) Days of the week on which the policy takes a snapshot: one or more of mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, and sun.
- `time` (String) Time of day in UTC at which the policy takes a snapshot, as HH:MM or HH:MM:SS.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import viettelcloud_volume_snapshot_policy.nightly 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001
```
